Chapter 6971: Destruction

Chapter 6971: Destruction

“Crackle!” Lightning lakes formed above Survivor Realm.

Godfiend hoped that after using the bone to ascend, he would become strong enough to defeat the immortal.

Afterward, he would banish or kill all invading immortals. Outsiders couldn’t interfere with his Survivor Realm from then on.

“Boom!” Golden lightning bolts and flames manifested into reality.

“Go!” He sent his godfiend aura toward the tribulation.

Since he wasn’t ready and forced the issue, the result was obvious. Thick lightning bolts pierced his body repeatedly, turning him into a bloody sieve despite his defenses.

The emperors could only watch. Any of those bolts could kill them and moreover, their overlord initiated this.

“Crack!” Fiery Bolts came from the outside world.

His tribulation harmonized with the tribulations in Ruin. Thus, they made their way into Survivor Realm.

“This is terrible!” Spectators had no hope for the monarch’s survival.

In this crucial moment, he raised the immortal bone. After a devastating shockwave, it bore the brunt of the tribulations.

“Rumble!” The immortal laws were activated, transforming into a gigantic bowl to take in the tribulations.

“Is this going to work?” The emperors exchanged glances and gradually became excited.

If the bone could absorb all the tribulations, then the overlord’s ascension was inevitable.

“A new immortal is coming.” Some spectators became emotional.

“We will have our own immortal.” Many were moved to tears.

Their realm couldn’t produce an immortal after Myriad Tribulations Immortal. Mundane Immortal still came from the outside world. Although she had left a lineage behind, she still departed in the end.

Thus, many big shots believed that although outsiders could be protectors, this couldn’t last forever. Only an immortal born here would protect them for epochs.

“I will become an immortal!” Godfiend’s confidence and excitement surged.

After becoming an immortal and with the help of the bone, he could slay any foreign invader and maintain peace for the land.

“Stop now!” Only Tribulation Daoist had a different sentiment from the rest.

“Buzz.” Cracks began to appear on the bone. Immortal rays oozed out from them.

There seemed to be a terrible ocean of tribulation hidden within, far more massive than a million Survivor Realm.

“Don’t, it will be apocalyptic!” Tribulation warned again upon seeing this, recalling his progenitor’s dark history.

Unfortunately, it was too late. The power of the bone engulfed all of Survivor Realm.

Godfiend’s hands holding the bone were pulverized in the blink of an eye. The shockwave sent him crashing against the ground; blood splashed everywhere.

“Rumble!” The immortal rays intensified with time.
